# Workshop Computer programs

Programs for the Music Thing Modular Workshop System Computer, vendored unmodified from
[TomWhitwell/Workshop_Computer](https://github.com/TomWhitwell/Workshop_Computer) for the Boy Rev B
apps in `src/revb`. Each keeps its own licence file. They build against Rev B's `ComputerCard.h`
(`src/revb/card/`), not the one they ship with, which is left out here.

| Directory | Program | From | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bends/` | Bends v1.0.0, Vincent Maurer | `releases/45_bends` at commit `6d47f07` | MIT |
